description: This Java source file defines the class OpenmrsPropertyLookup, which provides access to certain OpenMRS configuration properties for integration with Log4j logging framework. It exposes properties like application directory, log location, and log layout to be used dynamically in log configurations.

classes.name: OpenmrsPropertyLookup
classes.description: A log4j plugin class that exposes certain OpenMRS system properties to the logging configuration, enabling dynamic property retrieval within log configs.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Overrides the lookup method to return specific OpenMRS properties based on the provided key.

methods.name: getGlobalProperty
methods.description: Retrieves and trims the value of a specified global property from the OpenMRS administration service.
